wwo.name: Rio de Janeiro
wwo.method: Reis cadastral street axes follow the old ferry city, port-side streets, the Gloria and Catete coast and the northwestern railway edge. Coast, port working ground, undeveloped contour slopes, parks, and enclosed drawn street blocks use different historical geometry. Cloth seam, hand-read controls and incomplete individual building evidence keep this plan provisional. Park centers are approximate registration controls. Approximate placement from the low block archetype is confined to drawn blocks with selected street frontages.

registration.model: Single affine from hand-read source pixels to WGS84. Near-north raster is the 3840 px public-domain derivative cropped to x=590..2280/y=820..1940 and rotated 138 degrees counterclockwise with expansion to 2006 by 1964.
registration.seam: The joined original sheets have a dark, visually continuous diagonal paper seam in the working rotation. West sheet has one matched palace block center. Rail and street segments crossing the seam follow the visible same alignments on each side. Their near-view absolute accuracy is unverified.

controls.name: Saude summit symbol, approximate historical church match
Quinta da Boa Vista palace courtyard block center
Outeiro da Gloria summit symbol, approximate historical church match
Largo do Machado historical square center

registration.limitations: Controls are plot markers or area centers, with image-center interpretation noted. Church marks are point candidates only. Sao Cristovao parish church, moved entrance gates and ambiguously placed names were excluded. The cross-sheet track and port slopes cannot yet be used for meter-scale alignment.

sources.date: Manoel Pereira Reis; Rio de Janeiro: Lith. do Archivo Militar, 1900
sources.licence: Historic public-domain map. Credit Library of Congress Geography and Map Division.
sources.precision: Printed on two sheets, viewed in the joined 3840 by 2165 public-domain copy. Solid street traces and mapped physical edges only. Consult control residuals for the limits of hand registration.

properties.use_basis: Working extent of the source-derived geometry. Its closure is a processing boundary.
